ORDER BY sj.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM saved_jobs sj JOIN job_postings jp ON jp.job_posting_id = sj.job_posting_id JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = jp.company_id WHERE sj.user_id = #{userId} AND jp.status NOT IN ('임시저장', '숨김', '재검토요청', '삭제')
